contracts.title: Canonical Favorite Store origin and ownership
contracts.ownerDecision: The shared Favorite Store is the sole metadata and persistence owner; stored image URLs must remain same-origin.
contracts.notes: This is a narrow source contract. Browser behavior remains owned by the existing Home and Izbrannoe route tests.

contracts.title: Home premium native contract
contracts.ownerDecision: The current native Home is the approved render owner; legacy HTML is historical evidence and generic-template substitution is forbidden.
allowedDeviations: Legacy-vs-native pixel differences are diagnostic when the named native guards remain green.

contracts.title: Gill mobile chrome and navigation
contracts.ownerDecision: Gill must retain its canonical GBS2 identity and mobile controls while allowing the approved native TOC implementation to differ from the historical sheet.
allowedDeviations: The current gbs2 TOC scroller may replace the historical toc-sheet structure.
Accessibility corrections may change non-semantic wrapper markup.

contracts.title: Unified command palette accessibility contract
contracts.ownerDecision: One command palette owns global search; accessibility and focus behavior must not be approximated by route-local copies.
allowedDeviations: Strict-native app routes may keep their own local search in addition to the global palette.

contracts.title: Nagornaya independent legacy-preserve world
contracts.ownerDecision: Nagornaya remains an independent visual and navigation world and must not be normalized into a generic shared series shell.
contracts.doNotModernizeReason: A broad rewrite is expensive, owner-rejected and likely to destroy route-specific information architecture.
allowedDeviations: Bounded accessibility and bug fixes are allowed when the independent visual identity remains intact.

contracts.title: Karty native map runtime contract
contracts.ownerDecision: Map correctness is defined by route data, the shared engine and browser behavior rather than approximate resemblance to a static mockup.
allowedDeviations: The minimap may evolve visually while route geography, interaction and error-free runtime remain protected.

contracts.title: Home mobile hero hub review
contracts.ownerDecision: The mobile hub should shorten navigation without introducing a detached or generic block.
allowedDeviations: Kicker and action affordances may be redesigned after owner review.
Desktop composition may differ from mobile.

contracts.title: Baptists 3D app split target
contracts.ownerDecision: Split the oversized app only in a bounded performance lane with before/after measurements; do not introduce a premature global size gate.

contracts.title: TTS lazy route loading target
contracts.ownerDecision: Keep the governed TTS runtime off catalogs and unrelated landings, but require measured route ownership before adding a blocking bundle assertion.

contracts.title: Legacy duplicate inventory
contracts.ownerDecision: Count duplicates recursively and use the result to plan bounded removals; the count itself must not block unrelated Product work.
